name: Machine Single-Arm Shoulder Press
steps: Adjust the seat of an independent-arm press so the handle is at shoulder height, then sit with both feet planted.
Set your back against the pad, grasp one handle and steady your free hand on your hip or the frame.
Press the handle smoothly overhead until your arm is extended without snapping your elbow into lockout.
Lower the handle slowly back to shoulder level, and switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep both shoulders level against the backrest instead of tilting away from the loaded arm.
Maintain a stacked wrist directly above your elbow throughout the press.
